name: wavical
description: A lightweight, security-first, AI-native desktop app framework built in Rust using OS WebView2, capability-gated IPC, optional sandboxed Node.js backends, and signed auto-updates.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const f of ['wavical.exe','wavical-shell.exe']){const src='target/release/'+f, dst='bin/'+f; if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); if(!fs.existsSync(dst)){console.error('Missing '+dst); process.exit(1);}}"
